title: 第4章 员外府

第4章员外府
人间修者，境界可分为三关九境。
其中人关修自身，是为锻体、凝气、神意；地关修外物，是为金丹、五行、法体；天关修大道，是为问道、天元、通玄。
三教、武者、妖魔、旁门……体系虽多，也不过大同小异。
蜀山派必须以劳动换资源，虽然看上去冷酷了一些，但也是为了历练弟子。实际上，对于弟子还是呵护的。就像第一境、第二境的弟子，不许接下山任务，只能在山门之内，接一些灵植维护、灵禽饲养、堂口执事……等等杂务。
而神意境，行走江湖时已经可以称得上是高手，在蜀山派却只是可以下山除妖的门槛而已。
都是下山除妖，也有很大区别。最受喜爱的，当属大户人家的诡案。
首先城池之中不比山野，基本就不会有什么大妖出没，危险程度较低。其次繁华热闹，除妖之余还可以游玩一番。最后，大户人家出手阔绰，除了交给山门请托的费用，完事之后的谢礼也往往丰厚，而这都是给除妖者本人的，足够小赚一笔。
沈老帮楚梁挑的，就是这么个活计。
“楚少侠好！”
“明员外好。”
“楚少侠辛苦了！”
“为百姓服务。”
“……”
楚梁御剑来到邢州城外，而后走到城中明员外的府邸讲明身份，立刻就受到了热情的接待。
明员外是个身材瘦削的中年男人，气质儒雅，颔下有短须，给人印象倒是不错。就是眼窝发黑，神情憔悴，看上去被折磨得不轻。
“有你这蜀山派的少侠来了，我们家可就能安宁咯。”明员外一路拉着楚梁，到堂前坐下，吩咐下人斟茶倒水，而后感慨道。
“还是先请讲一讲具体情况吧。”楚梁微笑道。
“唉……”明员外叹口气，道：“我明家祖辈都是积善之家，也不知为何会遇上这等怪事……”
“就是三日前，府外开始有诡异的猫叫声，凄厉哀婉，瘆人之极。两日前，那猫叫声出现在了我家前院，有府中家丁亲眼看到了那妖物，周身血气滔天！到得昨日，那猫叫声已经来到了我家后院！我夫人都受到了惊扰……”

“少侠……”他恳切地看着楚梁，“若是再不阻止它，恐怕今夜就要入我家杀人了啊！”
明员外的行动也算是快，在第二日就跑到城外道观寻求帮助。
通常这些香火繁盛的道观寺庙，不是有修行者驻扎，就是与某一座仙门有所联系，否则也无法做大。邢州城外的这座道观，就与蜀山派联系密切，所以这个任务的请托也第一时间到了蜀山换剑阁。
“嗯……”楚梁闻言，沉思片刻。
这种只在夜间出现……一步步向前试探……不像是妖，倒像是灵，也就是所谓的“鬼”。
毕竟妖物如果修为有成，灵智与人无异，做事也不会这样难以捉摸。只有修为不高的鬼物，因为死过一次灵智缺失，才有可能受到生前怨念驱使做出一些奇怪的举动。
像是这只猫妖……
就有可能是一只死去的猫灵。
想到这，楚梁便问道：“府上前几日，可曾打死过猫吗？”
“自是不曾……”明员外摇头道：“我家夫人极有爱心，向来善待动物。周围流浪的野猫野狗，也一向派家人悉心喂养。”
楚梁来到时，就已经是下午，问问具体情况再四下巡视一番，就已经临近天黑了。
府上赶紧设宴款待。
毕竟再晚一点，猫妖就该上线了。
席上珍馐美宴自不必说，明员外和楚梁坐在那里，身后各有一名侍女服侍，都是银剑峰上绝对享受不到的待遇。
只是等了好一会儿，人还未齐，又有侍女来报道：“老爷，夫人说她身子不适又有些加重，实在无法来赴宴，还请楚少侠与老爷勿怪。”
“呀……”明员外立刻满脸焦急，站起身来，看看楚梁，告罪道：“楚少侠莫怪，我先去看看我家夫人，去去就来。”
说罢，就把楚梁扔在这，一路小跑回后院去了。
楚梁倒也不以为恼，只是微笑道：“明员外与夫人感情真是好。”
“是啊。”旁边侍女不无艳羡地说道：“我家老爷与夫人成亲十年了，依旧如胶似漆。前些年夫人因病无法生育，还劝老爷纳妾生子，可老爷至今都不肯纳妾。”
另一名侍女也感慨道：“只有夫人这般人美心善的女子，才当得起老爷这么情深义重吧。”

片刻之后，明员外又急匆匆赶回来。
“夫人没大碍吧？”楚梁问道。
“无妨，只是这几天邪祟作乱，夫人受到些惊扰，身子不适。只要能除了此妖物，自然就好了。”明员外道。
“我必竭尽全力。”楚梁道。
酒席未完，就听外面一阵风声。
阴风伴随着妖气，隆隆席卷起来，嘭的吹开堂门，将宴席碗筷卷得噼啪作响。
“是那猫妖，它又来了！”明员外惊呼一声。
楚梁立刻身形一掠，来到门前，仔细感受了一下这股气息。
阴气很重，有鬼物。可又杂着妖风浓烈，莫非……
“有些古怪，你们先躲……”楚梁回过身，想要劝明家的非战斗人员先躲避好。
可是一回头，就发现整座宴席厅堂空空荡荡，除了自己哪还有一个人影。远远风中传来明员外留下的声音，“楚少侠，靠你了……”
跑得是真快啊。
先前还担心明家人的安危，现在他觉得自己的担心完全是多余的。就照这个逃跑速度，估计整座邢州城都被妖怪攻陷了，他们也不会有事。
“喵嗷——”
来不及多想，一声刺耳的尖锐叫声已然响起，着实凄厉慑人。
“呔！”楚梁清喝一声，飞剑手环一扬，化作长剑握在手里，走出厅堂。
一眼，就看见了外面的滔天血气！
在宅邸的院墙之上，正弓身趴伏着一只猫脸怪物，一双异瞳，泛着死寂的白。满脸黑毛沾满污血，看上去十分幼小。最奇怪的是，这妖物虽然是猫头，身子仿佛是人类婴孩儿，满身污血，却没有毛发。
狰狞可怖！
楚梁见之，都不由得心头一紧。

此物……。
是怨灵，即怨气滔天所化鬼物！又是婴灵，即是未出世的婴孩死亡，怨气比寻常鬼怪更强十倍！还是妖灵，即妖物死后化鬼！
难怪它如此诡异，怨灵、婴灵、妖灵……每一种单独讲都算是鬼物之中较为特别的存在。
而眼前这只根本就是……
叠满了！

Chapter 4 Yuanwaifu
The realm of cultivators in the human world can be divided into three levels and nine realms.
Among them, human beings cultivate themselves for the purpose of tempering the body, condensing Qi, and divine will; earth gate cultivates external objects for the purpose of golden elixir, five elements, and dharma bodies; Tian gate cultivates the great road for the purpose of Taoism, Tianyuan, and Tongxuan.
The three religions, warriors, demons, side sects... Although there are many systems, they are mostly the same.
The Shushan sect must exchange labor for resources. Although it seems a bit colder, it is also to train its disciples. In fact, he still protects his disciples. Just like the disciples in the first and second realms, they are not allowed to take on tasks from the mountain. They can only take on some chores such as maintenance of spiritual plants, raising spiritual birds, hall deacons, etc. within the mountain gate.
As for Shen Yujing, one can already be called a master when traveling in the world, but in the Shushan sect, it is just the threshold for being able to go down the mountain and slay demons.
They both go down the mountain to slay demons, but there is a big difference. The most beloved one is undoubtedly the mystery of a wealthy family.
First of all, the city is no different from the mountains and there are basically no big monsters coming out, so the level of danger is low. Secondly, it is bustling and lively, and you can have some fun while getting rid of monsters. Finally, wealthy families spend a lot of money. In addition to the fees paid to the mountain gate, the thank you gifts after the work is completed are often generous, and these are all given to the demon slayer himself, which is enough to make a small profit.
This is the job that Mr. Shen helped Chu Liang choose.
"Hello, Young Master Chu!"
"It's a good thing to be a member of the Ming Dynasty."
"Thank you for your hard work, Young Master Chu!"
"Serve the people."
"..."
Chu Liang Yujian came to the outside of Xingzhou City, and then walked to the mansion outside the city to identify himself, and was immediately warmly received.
Officer Ming is a thin, middle-aged man with an elegant temperament and a short beard, which gives him a good impression. His eye sockets were black, his expression was haggard, and he looked tortured.
"With you, a young knight from the Shushan sect, our family will be at peace." Ming Yuanwai pulled Chu Liang all the way to sit down in front of the hall, ordered his servants to pour tea and water, and then sighed with emotion.
"Please tell me the specific situation first." Chu Liang said with a smile.
"Alas..." Ming Yuanwai sighed and said, "My Ming family's ancestors are all good people. I don't know why we encountered such strange things..."
"Three days ago, there started to be a strange meowing sound outside my house. It was sad, sad, and extremely scary. Two days ago, the meowing sound appeared in my front yard. A servant in the house saw the monster with his own eyes, and his body was filled with blood! As of yesterday, the meowing sound came to my backyard! My wife was even disturbed..."
"Young hero..." He looked at Chu Liang sincerely, "If you don't stop it, I'm afraid he will enter my house and kill someone tonight!"
Ming Yuanwai acted very quickly and ran to the Taoist temple outside the city to seek help on the second day.
Usually these Taoist temples with prosperous incense either have practitioners stationed there or are connected to a certain immortal sect, otherwise they will not be able to grow in size. This Taoist temple outside Xingzhou City has close ties with the Shushan Sect, so the requester for this task immediately arrived at the Shushan Sword Changing Pavilion.
"Well..." Chu Liang heard this and thought for a moment.
This kind only appears at night...step by step to test...not like a demon, but like a spirit, which is the so-called "ghost".
After all, if a monster is successful in cultivation, its intelligence will be the same as that of a human being, and its actions will not be so elusive. Only ghosts with low cultivation levels may be driven by the resentment of their lifetimes to do some strange actions because they have lost their intelligence after dying once.
Like this cat demon...
It could be a dead cat spirit.
Thinking of this, Chu Liang asked: "Have you ever killed a cat in the past few days?"
"I have never..." Ming Yuanwai shook his head and said, "My wife is very caring and always treats animals well. The wild cats and dogs wandering around have always been carefully fed by my family."
When Chu Liang arrived, it was already afternoon. After asking about the specific situation and looking around, it was already getting dark.
The house quickly held a banquet to entertain him.
After allLater, the cat demon will be online.
Needless to say, there was a delicious feast at the table. Ming Yuanwai and Chu Liang were sitting there, with a maid serving behind them. They were all treatments that could never be enjoyed on Silver Sword Peak.
After waiting for a while, before everyone was here, another maid came to report: "Sir, Madam said that she is feeling unwell and getting a little worse, so she really can't come to the banquet. Please don't blame me, Master Chu and Master."
"Yeah..." Ming Yuanwai immediately looked anxious. He stood up, looked at Chu Liang, and said, "Young Master Chu, don't blame me. I'll go see my wife first. I'll come back as soon as I go."
After that, he left Chu Liang here and ran back to the backyard.
Chu Liang didn't feel annoyed at all, he just smiled and said, "The relationship between Ming Yuanwai and his wife is really good."
"Yes." The maid next to her said with envy: "My husband and wife have been married for ten years, and they are still inseparable. A few years ago, my wife was unable to have children due to illness, and she even persuaded the master to take a concubine and have children, but the master still refuses to take a concubine."
Another maid also sighed with emotion: "Only a woman as kind-hearted as Madam can be worthy of being so affectionate and loyal as the Master."
After a while, Ming Yuanwai hurried back.
"Is Madam okay?" Chu Liang asked.
"It's okay, it's just that the evil spirits have been causing chaos these past few days, and my wife has been disturbed a little and is feeling unwell. As long as we can get rid of this monster, it will be fine." Ming Yuan said.
"I will do my best." Chu Liang said.
Before the banquet was over, I heard a gust of wind outside.
The dark wind, accompanied by the evil spirit, rumbled across the hall, blowing open the hall door and making the banquet bowls and chopsticks crackle.
"It's that cat demon, it's here again!" Ming Yuanwai exclaimed.
Chu Liang immediately moved to the door and felt the breath carefully.
The yin energy is very strong and there are ghosts. But there is also a strong demonic wind, could it be...
"It's a little weird, you should hide first..." Chu Liang turned around, trying to persuade the non-combatants of the Ming family to hide first.
But when he turned around, he found that the entire banquet hall was empty, and there was no one except himself. In the distant wind came the voice left by Ming Yuanwai, "Young Master Chu, it's up to you..."
He ran so fast.
He was worried about the safety of Ming's family before, but now he feels that his worries are completely unnecessary. At this speed of escape, it is estimated that the entire Xingzhou City will be captured by monsters, and they will be fine.
"Meow-"
Before he had time to think about it, a piercing scream sounded, which was really sad and terrifying.
"Hey!" Chu Liangqing shouted, raised the Feijian bracelet, turned into a long sword, held it in his hand, and walked out of the hall.
At a glance, he saw the overwhelming blood energy outside!
On the courtyard wall of the mansion, a cat-faced monster was crouching down, with a pair of strange eyes that glowed a dead white. His face was covered in black hair and stained with blood, and he looked very young. The strangest thing is that although this monster has a cat head and a body like a human baby, it is covered in blood but has no hair.
Terrible and terrifying!
When Chu Liang saw this, he couldn't help but feel nervous.
This thing….
It's a resentful spirit, a ghost transformed by overwhelming resentment! It’s the infant spirit again, that is, the death of an unborn baby, and its resentment is ten times stronger than ordinary ghosts! Or a demon spirit, that is, a demon turns into a ghost after death!
No wonder it is so weird. Wraith spirits, infant spirits, demon spirits...each of them individually is considered a special existence among ghosts.
And the one in front of me is simply...
The stack is full!
